document.title: Morgan Martinez - Lead Product Designer
document.content:
Morgan Martinez
Lead Product Designer

Skills:
Motion Design, Figma, User Research, Prototyping, Photoshop, Usability Testing, After Effects, Illustrator, Interaction Design, UI Design

Experience:
Lead Product Designer with extensive experience building scalable systems and leading cross-functional teams. Proven track record of delivering high-quality products on time and mentoring junior developers.

Key Achievements:
• Led development of mission-critical features
• Improved system performance by 40%
• Mentored team members and improved code quality
• Implemented best practices and coding standards
